caption: The video captures an outdoor dirt field on an overcast day, backed by a wooded hill and a playground with slides and shelters. A person in a teal shirt printed with SUMMER stands with their back to the camera near center-left, while a crouching adult attends to a small child at the left edge. At the center, an operator in a floral teal shirt holds two thin wands and manipulates a soap film. The transparent film grows from a small loop into a broad triangular sheet rising above the operator's head. A foreground puddle mirrors the standing figures in colored reflections. On the right, a child in a striped shirt, a person in a green numbered shirt, and a crouching adult in teal remain in place. As the clip continues, the stretched film develops iridescent green and pink coloration and expands into a large, tall sheet relative to the operator. A small greenish bubble resting on the ground to the operator's right remains visible throughout. The green-shirted person briefly raises an arm mid-clip. The hill and trees remain fixed.
